{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjccM8AAAABZe0J8A", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IfzhDGBVc", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3If", "number": 45, "title": "Correct V30MZ shift and rotate flags across all three WonderSwan models", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `90ef271b149b95e3143d9459324d4820b8403d77`, `crates/ws-core/src/cpu.rs:278–325` retains AF for shifts and updates OF only when the masked count is one. Independent WonderSwan CPU experiments report deterministic AF/OF behavior for zero and multi-bit counts too. Incorrect flags can change subsequent conditional branches across WonderSwan, WonderSwan Color and SwanCrystal; commercial-title impact remains unmeasured.

Static reproduction: `C0 E8 00` (`SHR AL,0`), AL=`40`, FLAGS=`F002`, currently retains `F002`; the experiment-backed expectation is `F802`. This example was derived from inspected code and sources, not executed during planning.

## Expected outcome

Correct ROL/ROR/RCL/RCR and SHL/SHR/SAR for byte/word operands and implicit-one, CL and immediate counts through ordinary decoding (`D0–D3`, `C0/C1`, documented extensions):

- Mask counts to five bits. Preserve CF when that masked count is zero; otherwise retain correct last-shifted-bit CF and operand results.
- Shifts clear AF and derive SZP from the result, including an unchanged operand at masked count zero. Rotates preserve AF/SZP.
- For every masked count, left operations set OF to final CF XOR result MSB; right operations set OF to the XOR of the result's two highest bits.
- Preserve unrelated flags, architectural state, decoding, bus accounting and shared-clock scheduling.

Keep undocumented `/6`, division, single-step delivery and timing redesign separate.

## Context

The clean checkout and inspected remote main match the baseline. Open Issues/PRs are empty; closed history contains no equivalent completed correction. Preserve prior CPU acceptance, particularly #35, #39, #41 and #43.

The [NEC V30MZ manual](https://www.renesas.com/en/document/lbr/v30mztm-hardware-preliminary), §3.1.5, defines one-bit overflow and leaves multi-bit overflow and auxiliary carry unspecified. It does not establish retention. The pinned [WSCPUTest report](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSCPUTest/blob/245b12c06dede4a2bb9c04c942ebca2044ba4930/README.md) supplies the console-specific rules above, explicitly including bits 7/15 and masked-zero counts. Its [assembly experiments](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSCPUTest/blob/245b12c06dede4a2bb9c04c942ebca2044ba4930/WSCpuTest.asm#L2935) compare results/full flags under contrasting incoming flags through line 4340.

Correction record: replace the old AF/OF retention assumptions in `cpu.rs`, its tests around lines 1498–1555, and `docs/hardware-subset.md:291–295` with these experiment-backed requirements. Retain correct zero-count SZP behavior and unrelated acceptance. Document the old assumption, corrected requirement, source and rationale; technical corrections require no human approval or independent AI re-review.

Evidence limits: inspected assembly covers byte shifts/rotates and word carry rotations, primarily with CL counts; the report explicitly describes both widths. Distinguish direct experiment coverage from applying those semantics to other documented operand/count forms. No physical execution or per-model measurement log was independently inspected.

[Saved #43 validation](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/90ef271b149b95e3143d9459324d4820b8403d77/docs/issue-43-validation.md) reports 125 core tests, 19 integration tests, one adapter test and both complete Chromium suites passing, plus Coordinator acceptance review. These are reported results; existing tests were inspected but not rerun here. Commercial titles remain untested.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record the source reconciliation and applicability limits, then correct all seven operations, both widths and all three count sources through normal decoding. Introduce no game-specific behavior or fallback.
- [ ] Add independent result/full-FLAGS vectors with opposing incoming AF/OF/CF/SZP and control flags. Cover zero/nonzero, sign boundaries, raw counts 0/32, one/multiple bits, width and carry-ring boundaries, 31 and larger masked counts. Distinguish nonzero full rotations from masked-zero counts; check untouched state and CL/destination aliasing.
- [ ] Exercise physical Mono plus Color/Crystal in mono and color modes, including runtime transitions. Before changing production behavior, record actual failures for zero-count OF, shift AF and multi-bit OF, followed by corrected passes.
- [ ] Cover register and writable mapped RAM/SRAM destinations, aligned/odd words and segment overrides. Check exact continuation/IP, operand access charges, existing execution-cost components and one shared-device advance. Preserve prefix, interrupt-shadow, HALT, REP, BUSLOCK, FPO1/POLL and multiplication regressions.
- [ ] Add an original source-included CC0 probe covering every operation, both widths and count sources. Independently assert actual CPU-written results/full flags and subsequent branch decisions natively and through the production Chromium/Wasm player on all three models and restart. Poison retained observations and require fresh boot/completion markers. Record native baseline failure and corrected native/browser results.
- [ ] Preserve three-model gates, firmware-free startup, LCD behavior, audio/PCM, GDMA/SDMA/Hyper Voice, SRAM, both EEPROM controllers, browser save integrity, input/frame continuity and ownership/provenance. Keep unrelated assertions and existing fixture/demo bytes.
- [ ] Before merge, Coordinator runs and records `python3 fixtures/build.py --check`, `python3 demo/build.py --check`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `git diff --check`. In `web`, run `npm run build:wasm` and `npm run build`, then complete `npm run test:browser` and `npm run test:compat` sequentially against that production build, including the new probe.
- [ ] Update hardware-support documentation, fixture provenance and validation evidence. Coordinator reviews every checkbox against the final diff before merge and resolves blocking findings. Separate tests present from checks actually executed; record failures, skipped checks and remaining uncertainty without weakening acceptance.

## Optional validation

Expand independently calculated operand vectors or run the original probe against the unchanged baseline in production Chromium for additional discrimination. Neither proprietary ROMs/firmware nor human gameplay is required. Probe success establishes bounded hardware behavior, not commercial-catalog compatibility.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WonderSwan-family hardware goal.
Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance criteria when primary hardware
specifications establish the correction. Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
